Synopsis:
Goldman Sachs senior counsel Kathryn Ruemmler is scheduled to testify before the House Oversight Committee regarding her extensive ties to convicted sex offender Jeffrey Epstein. She resigned as Goldman's CLO/General Counsel in late June after DOJ documents revealed she had significant communications with Epstein (2014–2019), accepted gifts from him, and advised him on media strategy. Goldman's decision to retain her in an advisory role post-resignation has drawn congressional criticism. Key lawmakers including Krishnamoorthi and Ro Khanna will question her on what she knew about Epstein's criminal network. The investigation is part of a broader congressional probe into Epstein's crimes and federal handling of his cases.
